corpus: sample_corpus_nonprofit/ (Bayside Community Pantry — INVENTED nonprofit, sample data only) and sample_corpus/ (Harbor & Pine Law — fictional firm, sample data only)
note: Extended eval (Principles of Building AI Agents ch. 27 categories). Every case is checked for answer-vs-decline and, when answered, citation to an expected source; expected_path checks the router's route; expected_section checks the cited section; previous_question makes it a follow-up. known_limitation cases are real failures kept visible: reported every run, not counted toward the pass/fail exit code. Regression cases (R*) guard the Qodo PR #2 fixes; "answerable": null means either outcome is acceptable as long as the forbidden route/source/section is not used.

questions.question: List the documents
What is the deadline for the flat fee?
questions.why: Qodo PR #2 finding 1: the heading 'What the flat fee covers' shares two words with the question but states no deadline; the section route must not answer from it.

questions.question: What's the client's fee?
questions.why: Qodo PR #2 finding 8: two apostrophes were read as quotes around "s the client" and answered from the confidentiality policy.

questions.question: Which policy mentions 'locked filing cabinet'?
questions.why: Real single quotes around a phrase must still use the exact-phrase tool after the finding 8 fix.

questions.question: Can I donate a homemade lasagna?
questions.why: The donations policy says home-cooked food cannot be accepted, but the keyword gate does not know 'homemade' = 'home-cooked', so it declines (false decline). Needs embeddings (the SIE swap) or synonyms.

questions.question: What is the executive director's salary?
questions.why: No salary is in the documents, but 'executive director' shares two words with the AI-tools section, so the keyword gate passes and quotes an unrelated passage (false answer).

questions.question: What is the deadline for the flat fee?
questions.why: After the finding 1 fix the section route no longer answers, but the RAG fallback still quotes 'What the flat fee covers' first: the keyword gate passes on 2 of 3 words (flat, fee). Needs a stronger relevance signal (embeddings) to fix without breaking fee questions phrased as 'cost'.
